A trade review should not start with the arrow.

It should start with the bias, the liquidity in the way, and the reaction that made the idea executable.

This week, the charts came from EURUSD and Gold.

The screenshots show the execution. The Looms show the decisions behind it: waiting for liquidity to be taken, questioning the first reaction, and changing the entry when the original route no longer made sense.

The entry is the last step.
